summary.headline: Run 109 on main has four failures and one is a product regression: the rounding change 613509c8 makes a half-price fare print 12.12 instead of 12.13 (fails again on re-run; drafted). The others are a fixture booking dated in the past (test data, drafted), a slot-picking test that passed on re-run (flaky, hand to flaky-test-hunter), and the internal package index giving no versions in both attempts (environment). The docs commit in range is not involved.

limitations: The CI responses are recorded: the logs and JUnit are real local runs of the sample, inside envelopes shaped like the GitHub Actions REST API; no CI system was called and the re-run was recorded, not triggered.
Run history has two runs on main (the green run 101 and this one), so no earlier outcomes of each test on this commit were available beyond the re-run.
The data failure is indicated by a date marker and a signature; it was not confirmed by running with a shifted clock.
The environment failure names a loopback index in the sample; on a real runner, check the index host and the runner network.
